purpose: Per-binding capability status for the E3 candidate-source gate. Rows are claims about what is actually verified, bound to an existing backend binding from data/locale/backend-bindings.json and to a committed evidence path. tests/capability_matrix enforces the schema, the status vocabulary, evidence existence, and two hard rules of format 1: nothing may claim host_verified, and every host_acceptance row stays not_implemented until a real registered host acceptance is recorded (which requires a format bump and a validator change). A language identity without a verified engine is never a capability row with a positive status.
